# 設 — establish; provide

**Strokes:** 11 · **Key (radical):** 言 (no. 149) · **JLPT:** N2 (community list)

## Meaning and origin

設 concerns setting something up, establishing it or providing what is needed. 設備 names equipment or facilities, while 建設 concerns construction or establishment.

**Modern-shape mnemonic, not etymology:** Picture 言 on the left announcing that a new facility is being set up, while the 殳-shaped right side supplies the tools. This is a visual story, not an explanation of the character's historical construction.

## Readings

| Reading | Type | Typical words |
| --- | --- | --- |
| セツ | on | [設備](../words/設備.md) せつび - equipment; facilities |
| もう.ける | kun | 設ける もうける - provide; set up; establish |

## Common words

- [設備](../words/設備.md) せつび - equipment; facilities
- [建設](../words/建設.md) けんせつ - construction; establishment
- [設計](../words/設計.md) せっけい - design; planning

## Notes

- 設ける is a transitive ichidan verb. The spelling and reading belong together; do not substitute the sound of the on reading into this native verb.
- 設計 is せっけい, with a small っ from セツ + ケイ. Setting out a design is not the same activity as completing the construction.

# 初 — first time; initial

**Strokes:** 7 · **Key (radical):** 刀 (no. 18) · **JLPT:** N3 (community list)

## Meaning and origin

初 marks a first occurrence or an initial stage. [初めて](../words/初めて.md) はじめて means "for the first time."
最初 さいしょ refers to the beginning or the first item; 初恋 はつこい is a first love.

**Modern-shape mnemonic:** the left side is 衤, the clothing form of 衣, beside 刀 on the right.
Imagine making the first cut in material for clothing. This is a memory aid, not a verified historical account.

## Readings

These examples select three readings; the full source list is preserved above.

| Reading | Type | Typical words |
| --- | --- | --- |
| はじ.めて | kun | [初めて](../words/初めて.md) はじめて — for the first time |
| はつ | kun | 初恋 はつこい — first love |
| ショ | on | 最初 さいしょ — beginning; first |

## Common words

- [初めて](../words/初めて.md) はじめて — for the first time
- 最初 さいしょ — beginning; first
- 初恋 はつこい — first love

## Notes

Use 初めて for the "first time" adverb when writing your own examples.
Distinguish that use from 始めて (はじめて), the linking form of [始める](../words/始める.md), "begin."
JMdict also records 始めて as a spelling of the adverb, so context matters: the written form alone does not always identify which word it is.
[切](切.md) also has a full 刀 on the right; [列](列.md) and [判](判.md) use its narrow form 刂 instead.
